<link rel="stylesheet" href="/app-mode.css">

<style>
.dcp-wrap { max-width: 1220px; margin: 0 auto; }
.dcp-wrap, .dcp-wrap * { box-sizing: border-box; }
/* app-like page: no title block, so the board sits at the top of the screen */
#title-block-header { display: none; }
@media (min-width: 992px) {
  #quarto-margin-sidebar { display: none; }
  #quarto-content main.content { grid-column: page-start-inset / page-end-inset !important; }
}

.dcp-cols { display: flex; gap: 26px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; margin-top: 10px; }
/* the board takes every pixel the calendar column does not need, like the
   Chess Coach page: greedy grow, capped so the whole card (header, quota,
   board, status, buttons) fits the viewport with no scrolling.
   787px column = 748px board once card padding and borders are taken off. */
.dcp-left { flex: 99 1 440px; min-width: 280px; max-width: min(787px, calc(100vh - 332px)); }
.dcp-right { flex: 1 1 250px; min-width: 220px; max-width: 300px; }

.dcp-card {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #e0e0e0); border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px 18px; margin-bottom: 16px; background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.dcp-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.dcp-day { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.dcp-sub { color: #888; font-size: .9rem; }
.dcp-user { font-size: .9rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.dcp-user b { color: var(--site-accent); }

/* board */
#dcpBoard {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(8, 1fr);
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; user-select: none; touch-action: none;
  border: 2px solid #b0b0b0;
}
.dcp-ghost { position: fixed; pointer-events: none; z-index: 999; opacity: .85; }
.dcp-sq { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; }
.dcp-sq img { width: 88%; height: 88%; pointer-events: none; }
/* stone and grass come from chess-assets/board-field.css; these stay as the
   fallback colors if that stylesheet ever fails to load */
.dcp-sq.light { background: #e7e1d4; }
.dcp-sq.dark { background: #5c7d40; }
.dcp-sq.sel { outline: 3px solid #f6c144; outline-offset: -3px; }
.dcp-sq.last { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(155, 199, 0, .28); }
.dcp-sq.hintsq { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(70, 130, 180, .38); }
.dcp-sq.wrongsq { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(204, 0, 0, .35); }
.dcp-sq .dot { position: absolute; width: 26%; height: 26%; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.18); }

.dcp-status { min-height: 26px; margin-top: 10px; font-size: .96rem; }
.dcp-status .ok { color: #1E6B3E; font-weight: 600; }
.dcp-status .bad { color: #CC0000; font-weight: 600; }

.dcp-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.dcp-btn {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--site-accent); color: var(--site-accent); background: transparent;
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: .92rem; cursor: pointer;
}
.dcp-btn:hover { background: var(--site-accent); color: var(--site-accent-contrast); }
.dcp-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
.dcp-btn:disabled:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--site-accent); }

/* progress pills for today's quota */
.dcp-quota { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin: 10px 0 2px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.dcp-pill { width: 26px; height: 10px; border-radius: 5px; background: #e3e3e3; border: none; padding: 0; }
.dcp-pill.done { background: #2E8B57; }

.dcp-pill.pick { cursor: pointer; }
.dcp-pill.pick:hover { outline: 2px solid var(--site-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* overall progress */
.dcp-prog-outer { background: #ececec; border-radius: 6px; height: 10px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 6px; }
.dcp-prog-inner { background: var(--site-accent); height: 100%; width: 0; transition: width .4s; }

/* calendar (compact: about half the board's width) */
.dcp-cal-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.dcp-cal-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: .9rem; }
.dcp-cal-nav { border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--site-accent); font-size: 1.05rem; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 8px; }
.dcp-cal-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 3px; }
.dcp-cal-dow { text-align: center; font-size: .62rem; color: #999; padding-bottom: 2px; }

  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: .7rem; color: #777;
}
.dcp-cal-cell.empty { background: transparent; }

.dcp-cal-cell.green:hover { background: #256e46; }
.dcp-cal-cell.today { outline: 2px solid var(--site-accent); outline-offset: -2px; }
.dcp-cal-cell.reviewing { outline: 2px solid #e67e22; outline-offset: -2px; }

.dcp-big {
  text-align: center; padding: 26px 12px; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.7;
}
.dcp-big .huge { font-size: 2rem; }
.dcp-note { font-size: .85rem; color: #999; margin-top: 10px; }
.dcp-stats { display: flex; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 4px; font-size: .92rem; color: #555; }

/* technique label + coach primer */
.dcp-tech { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--site-accent); font-weight: 600; margin: 2px 0 8px; }
.dcp-primer { max-width: 900px; margin-top: 4px; }

.dcp-primer-row { font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.55; margin: 4px 0; color: #444; }
.dcp-primer-row b { color: #222; }

  <p class="dcp-note" style="max-width: 900px;">One set of puzzles per day for 1000 days. Puzzles are grouped by tactical technique: a day introducing a new pattern is followed by a day mixing it back in with the last few you learned, so patterns stay recognizable once the lesson is over rather than fading after a single solve. Each full pass through the technique list climbs to a harder rating band. The final 270 days serve one puzzle a day rated 2600 and up — as hard as this collection gets. Skipped days are never lost; your next unsolved set always waits, and the calendar turns green on each day you finish a set — click any green day to replay it. Puzzles are drawn from the Lichess puzzle database (CC0), curated for quality, with trivial one-movers excluded. Your progress follows the name you joined the <a href="chess.html">Chess Coach</a> leaderboard with, or stays in this browser if you have not joined.</p>

<script type="module">
import { Chess } from './chess-assets/chess.js';

/* ---------- schedule: 1000 days. Days 1-730 keep the original quota ramp
   (10 -> 1 puzzle/day, stepping down every 73 days); days 731-1000 hold at
   1 extremely hard puzzle/day (see curate-daily-puzzles.py for how that
   tail is curated -- rating >=2600, preferring >=2700 per technique). ---------- */
const DAYS = 1000;
const quotaOf = d => d <= 730 ? 10 - Math.floor((d - 1) / 73) : 1;
const startIndex = d => {                                   // puzzles consumed before day d
  let s = 0;
  for (let k = 1; k < d; k++) s += quotaOf(k);
  return s;
};
const phaseName = (day, q) =>
  day > 730 ? 'extreme (2600+)' :
  q >= 9 ? 'easy' : q >= 7 ? 'easy-medium' : q >= 5 ? 'medium' :
  q >= 3 ? 'difficult' : q === 2 ? 'very difficult' : 'very difficult';

/* ---------- technique curriculum: display names + coach primers ----------
   Written carefully and conservatively: specific historical claims are only
   included where they're well-established chess lore, not invented for
   flavor. Many entries skip "history" and/or a closing note entirely where
   there's nothing genuinely worth adding beyond how the pattern works. */
const TECH_LABEL = {
  hangingPiece: 'Hanging Piece', fork: 'Fork', pin: 'Pin', skewer: 'Skewer',
  discoveredAttack: 'Discovered Attack', discoveredCheck: 'Discovered Check', doubleCheck: 'Double Check',
  deflection: 'Deflection', attraction: 'Attraction', clearance: 'Clearance', interference: 'Interference',
  capturingDefender: 'Capturing the Defender', xRayAttack: 'X-Ray Attack', trappedPiece: 'Trapped Piece',
  intermezzo: 'Intermezzo (Zwischenzug)',
  exposedKing: 'Exposed King', kingsideAttack: 'Kingside Attack', queensideAttack: 'Queenside Attack',
  mateIn2: 'Mate in Two', backRankMate: 'Back-Rank Mate', mateIn3: 'Mate in Three',
  mateIn4: 'Mate in Four', mateIn5: 'Mate in Five',
  pawnEndgame: 'Pawn Endgame', rookEndgame: 'Rook Endgame', bishopEndgame: 'Bishop Endgame',
  knightEndgame: 'Knight Endgame', queenEndgame: 'Queen Endgame', queenRookEndgame: 'Queen & Rook Endgame',
  advancedPawn: 'Advanced Pawn', promotion: 'Promotion', zugzwang: 'Zugzwang',
  quietMove: 'Quiet Move', defensiveMove: 'Defensive Move', sacrifice: 'Sacrifice',
  attackingF2F7: 'Attacking f2 / f7',
};
const PRIMERS = {
  hangingPiece: { how: "A piece with no defender at all. Before anything fancy, scan every one of the opponent's pieces and ask whether it's actually protected.",
    freq: "The single most common way games are decided below expert level — most blunders are simply an unguarded piece, not a deep combination." },
  fork: { how: "One piece attacks two or more enemy targets at once, so only one can be saved. Knights are the classic forking piece because their L-shaped attack is easy to miss.",
    freq: "One of the most frequent tactics in games at every level, knight forks especially.",
    history: "The 'family fork' — a knight forking king, queen, and rook simultaneously — is one of the most prized patterns in chess and shows up constantly in tactics books as the archetypal fork." },
  pin: { how: "A piece can't safely move because that would expose a more valuable piece behind it on the same line — often the king. A pin against the king is absolute: the pinned piece is completely immobile.",
    freq: "Extremely common, especially with bishops and rooks along open lines.",
    note: "A pinned piece is often not just stuck — it's a target: pile on more attackers than the defender can add, and it falls." },
  skewer: { how: "Like a pin in reverse: the more valuable piece is in front and forced to move, exposing the piece behind it. Line up a bishop, rook, or queen through both." },
  discoveredAttack: { how: "Move one piece out of the way and a different piece behind it suddenly attacks something. The piece that moved can make its own threat at the same time.",
    note: "Discovered attacks are prized precisely because the moving piece gets two jobs at once." },
  discoveredCheck: { how: "A discovered attack where the revealed piece gives check. Since check must be answered immediately, the piece that moved is often free to cause damage while the opponent deals with the king." },
  doubleCheck: { how: "A discovered check where the moving piece also gives check, attacking the king with two pieces at once. Blocking or capturing can only deal with one attacker, so the king almost always has to move.",
    freq: "Rare in practice, but when a double check is available it is very often winning, because the king's escape squares are usually more limited than the defender expects." },
  deflection: { how: "Force a defending piece away from the square or line it's guarding — with a check, a capture, or a threat it can't ignore — so whatever it was protecting falls." },
  attraction: { how: "Force a piece, often the king, onto a specific square — usually with a check or a capture it's obligated to make — so it lands somewhere your next move can exploit." },
  clearance: { how: "Move a piece out of the way, often with a sacrifice, so a square or line opens up for a different one of your own pieces." },
  interference: { how: "Place a piece between an enemy piece and whatever it's defending or attacking, cutting the connection along that line — the mirror image of clearance." },
  capturingDefender: { how: "Before taking the piece you actually want, first capture (or otherwise remove) whatever is protecting it, so it falls for free or at a profit." },
  xRayAttack: { how: "A rook, bishop, or queen attacks a target through one of the opponent's own pieces standing in the way — the attack behind it activates the moment that piece moves or is captured." },
  trappedPiece: { how: "A piece — often a knight or bishop that wandered too far forward — has no safe square to retreat to. Look for pieces that pushed ahead without an escape route." },
  intermezzo: { how: "Instead of playing the expected recapture or reply immediately, insert a forcing move first — a check, a bigger capture, a threat — then come back to finish the original idea once the position favors you more.",
    note: "The German term zwischenzug ('in-between move') is what most players actually call this, even in English." },
  exposedKing: { how: "The king has lost its pawn cover or sits on open lines. Even without an immediate tactic, an exposed king is a long-term weakness worth attacking with every piece available." },
  kingsideAttack: { how: "A coordinated assault on the side of the board where the enemy king has castled — pushing pawns toward it, opening files, and bringing pieces over to join in." },
  queensideAttack: { how: "The same idea as a kingside attack, mirrored to the other side of the board — most relevant when the enemy king castled queenside." },
  mateIn2: { how: "A forced checkmate reachable in exactly two moves, regardless of how the opponent replies to the first one. Solving these builds the habit of calculating a forcing line all the way to the end before playing the first move." },
  backRankMate: { how: "The king is trapped on its own first rank, boxed in by its own pawns, with a rook or queen delivering mate along that rank because there's no escape square.",
    freq: "Extremely common at every level — it's the main reason to keep a 'luft' (an escape square) for a castled king once the position opens up." },
  mateIn3: { how: "A forced mate found three moves deep. Requires calculating not just your own moves but the opponent's only defenses at each step, since a genuine 'mate in three' has to work against every possible reply." },
  mateIn4: { how: "The same idea as mate in three, one move deeper — real calculation stamina is needed to be sure every branch is actually forced." },
  mateIn5: { how: "The deepest of the forced-mate family here. At this depth it's less about spotting a pattern and more about disciplined, systematic calculation of every defense." },
  pawnEndgame: { how: "With most pieces traded off, precise king and pawn technique decides everything. A single tempo, or the opposition (facing kings with the move belonging to the wrong side), can be the whole game." },
  rookEndgame: { how: "The most common endgame type in practical play. Rooks belong behind passed pawns — yours to push them, the opponent's to stop them — and an active rook is worth more than extra pawns." },
  bishopEndgame: { how: "Bishops are strongest with pawns on both sides of the board, since each one only ever touches squares of one color.",
    note: "A bishop of the 'wrong' color for a passed pawn's queening square is a well-known way to hold a draw." },
  knightEndgame: { how: "Knights need several moves to cross the board, unlike a bishop or rook that can do it in one — so speed and pawn-race calculation matter more here than in most other endgames." },
  queenEndgame: { how: "Perpetual check is always a danger for both sides, and a single well-placed check or tempo can flip the result. Among the hardest endgames to calculate precisely." },
  queenRookEndgame: { how: "The heaviest, most tactical endgame pairing — mating nets and perpetual checks are both constantly in the air, and king safety often matters more than material count." },
  advancedPawn: { how: "A pawn pushed deep into enemy territory, especially the 6th or 7th rank, ties down defensive pieces and constantly threatens to promote." },
  promotion: { how: "Get a pawn to the far rank and it becomes a queen (or another piece of choice). Recognizing when a pawn race or a sacrifice clears the path to promote is a key endgame skill." },
  zugzwang: { how: "A position where the side to move would rather pass, because every available move makes things worse. Common in endgames, rare but devastating when found in the middlegame.",
    note: "The German word itself ('compulsion to move') is used untranslated in essentially every language's chess vocabulary." },
  quietMove: { how: "The winning move makes no check, no capture, and no obvious threat — which is exactly why it's easy to miss. It typically improves a piece or removes the opponent's only useful reply, setting up something forcing next.",
    freq: "Quiet moves stay genuinely hard to spot even for very strong players, unlike short forced mates, which get easier to categorize as puzzle difficulty rises." },
  defensiveMove: { how: "Instead of attacking, the best move neutralizes the opponent's threat — a save, a blockade, or a trade that defuses the danger. Knowing when to defend is as important as knowing when to attack." },
  sacrifice: { how: "Giving up material on purpose because what it buys — an attack, a mating net, a decisive positional gain — is worth more than the points on the board. Arguably the hardest tactical skill, since it means trusting a calculation instead of just counting pieces.",
    history: "Some of the most celebrated games in chess history are remembered specifically for one brilliant sacrifice — material was always a means, never the goal." },
  attackingF2F7: { how: "The square beside the king (f7 for Black, f2 for White) is defended by the king alone in the opening, before castling — the classic early weak point.",
    history: "This is exactly the weakness Scholar's Mate and the Fried Liver Attack are built around." },
};

function todaysTechniques(day) {
  const q = quotaOf(day), start = startIndex(day), seen = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < q; i++) {
    const row = puzzles && puzzles[start + i];
    const t = row && row[5];
    if (t && !seen.includes(t)) seen.push(t);
  }
  return seen;
}
function renderPrimer(tech) {
  const box = $('dcpPrimer');
  const p = tech && PRIMERS[tech];
  if (!p) { box.style.display = 'none'; box.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  box.style.display = 'block';
  let html = `<div class="dcp-primer-head">${TECH_LABEL[tech] || tech}</div>`;
  html += `<div class="dcp-primer-row"><b>How to spot it:</b> ${p.how}</div>`;
  if (p.freq) html += `<div class="dcp-primer-row"><b>How often it comes up:</b> ${p.freq}</div>`;
  if (p.history) html += `<div class="dcp-primer-row"><b>Worth knowing:</b> ${p.history}</div>`;
  if (p.note) html += `<div class="dcp-primer-row">${p.note}</div>`;
  box.innerHTML = html;
}
function renderTechLabel(day) {
  const techs = todaysTechniques(day);
  const el = $('dcpTechLabel');
  if (!techs.length) { el.style.display = 'none'; renderPrimer(null); return; }
  el.style.display = 'block';
  if (techs.length === 1) {
    el.textContent = `Today's technique: ${TECH_LABEL[techs[0]] || techs[0]}`;
    renderPrimer(techs[0]);
  } else {
    el.textContent = `Mixed review: ${techs.map(t => TECH_LABEL[t] || t).join(', ')}`;
    renderPrimer(null);
  }
}

/* ---------- identity: the site-wide sign-in ---------- */
const fdb = window.__dcpFdb || null;
const authP = window.__dcpAuthP || Promise.resolve(null);
let cloudProfile = null;   // { uid, name } while signed in

/* Progress lives under the reader's own account. Signed out, the page is
   entirely local, exactly as before. */
function dailyRef() {
  if (!cloudProfile || !fdb) return null;
  return fdb.ref('users/' + cloudProfile.uid + '/chess/daily');
}

const LOCAL_KEY = 'daily-chess-v1';
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const todayStr = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');

/* state = { done: {dayNumber: 'YYYY-MM-DD'}, cur: {day, solved} } */
let state = { done: {}, cur: null };

function loadLocal() {
  try { const v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_KEY)); if (v && v.done) return v; } catch (e) {}
  return { done: {}, cur: null };
}
const saveLocal = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) {} };

function mergeStates(a, b) {
  const out = { done: Object.assign({}, a.done), cur: a.cur };
  for (const [d, dt] of Object.entries(b.done || {})) if (!out.done[d]) out.done[d] = dt;
  const ca = a.cur, cb = b.cur;
  if (cb && (!ca || cb.day > ca.day || (cb.day === ca.day && cb.solved > ca.solved))) out.cur = cb;
  return out;
}

async function cloudLoad() {
  if (!cloudProfile || !fdb) return null;
  try {
    /* one deadline over the whole trip: auth handshake plus the read */
    const v = await Promise.race([
      (async () => {
        const ref = dailyRef();
        if (!ref) return undefined;
        const snap = await ref.once('value');
        return snap.val();
      })(),
      new Promise((res, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('timeout')), 8000))
    ]);
    if (v === undefined) return null;
    if (!v) return { done: {}, cur: null };
    return { done: v.done || {}, cur: v.cur || null };
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}
function cloudSave() {
  const ref = dailyRef();
  if (!ref) return;
  const payload = { done: state.done, updatedAt: Date.now() };
  if (state.cur) payload.cur = state.cur;
  ref.set(payload).catch(() => {});
}
const persist = () => { saveLocal(); cloudSave(); };

/* ---------- derived progress ---------- */
const daysDone = () => Object.keys(state.done).length;
const currentDay = () => {
  for (let d = 1; d <= DAYS; d++) if (!state.done[d]) return d;
  return null;                                            // all 730 done
};
function streak() {
  const dates = new Set(Object.values(state.done));
  let n = 0;
  const t = new Date();
  if (!dates.has(t.toLocaleDateString('en-CA'))) t.setDate(t.getDate() - 1);
  while (dates.has(t.toLocaleDateString('en-CA'))) { n++; t.setDate(t.getDate() - 1); }
  return n;
}

/* ---------- board ---------- */
const FILES = 'abcdefgh';
const BF_TILE = [0,1,2,3,  2,1,0,3,  3,0,1,2,  3,2,1,0];
let game = null, puzzle = null, solIdx = 0, userColor = 'w', selected = null, lastMove = null, boardLocked = true, hintStage = 0;

/* ---------- review: replay any completed day without touching live progress ----------
   reviewDay/reviewIdx stand in for state.cur/state.cur.solved while active; nothing
   here ever writes to state.done or state.cur, so exiting review resumes the live
   session exactly where it was. */
let reviewDay = null, reviewIdx = 0;
let liveReplay = null;   /* index of an already-solved puzzle being replayed inside the live day */
function activeCtx() {
  if (reviewDay !== null) return { day: reviewDay, idx: reviewIdx, review: true };
  if (state.cur && liveReplay !== null) return { day: state.cur.day, idx: liveReplay, review: false, replay: true };
  if (state.cur) return { day: state.cur.day, idx: state.cur.solved, review: false };
  return null;
}
function startReview(day) {
  if (!puzzles || !state.done[day]) return;
  reviewDay = day; reviewIdx = 0; liveReplay = null;
  renderCalendar();
  $('dcpBoard').style.display = 'grid';
  $('dcpHint').disabled = false; $('dcpRetry').disabled = false;
  startPuzzle();
}
function exitReview() {
  reviewDay = null; reviewIdx = 0; liveReplay = null;
  renderAll();
}
$('dcpExitReview').onclick = exitReview;

function sqName(r, c, flip) { return flip ? FILES[7 - c] + (r + 1) : FILES[c] + (8 - r); }
function drawBoard() {
  const el = $('dcpBoard');
  el.innerHTML = '';
  const flip = userColor === 'b';
  const pos = game ? game.board() : null;
  for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
    const sq = document.createElement('div');
    const name = sqName(r, c, flip);
    /* Battlefield highlight placement (see chess-assets/board-field.css): a 4x4
       tile, not a formula, so both square colors see all four variants. Keyed
       on the square name rather than the screen cell, so it survives a flip. */
    const bfv = BF_TILE[((+name[1] - 1) % 4) * 4 + (FILES.indexOf(name[0]) % 4)];
    sq.className = 'dcp-sq ' + (((r + c) % 2 === 0) ? 'light' : 'dark') + ' bf-v' + bfv;
    sq.dataset.sq = name;
    /* chess.js board(): index 0 = rank 8, columns a..h */
    const p = pos ? pos[flip ? 7 - r : r][flip ? 7 - c : c] : null;
    if (p) {
      const img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = 'chess-assets/pieces/' + p.color + p.type.toUpperCase() + '.svg';
      img.alt = p.color + p.type;
      sq.appendChild(img);
    }
    if (lastMove && (name === lastMove.from || name === lastMove.to)) sq.classList.add('last');
    if (selected === name) sq.classList.add('sel');
    el.appendChild(sq);
  }
}
function markMoves(from) {
  const ms = game.moves({ square: from, verbose: true });
  for (const m of ms) {
    const cell = document.querySelector(`[data-sq="${m.to}"]`);
    if (cell && !cell.querySelector('.dot')) {
      const dot = document.createElement('div'); dot.className = 'dot'; cell.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }
}
function flash(name, cls) {
  const cell = document.querySelector(`[data-sq="${name}"]`);
  if (!cell) return;
  cell.classList.add(cls);
  setTimeout(() => cell.classList.remove(cls), 700);
}

/* one pointer flow serves both input styles: click a piece then click the
   target, or press, drag the piece, and drop it on the target */
const boardWrap = $('dcpBoard');
let drag = null;
function squareUnder(e) {
  const el = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  const sq = el && el.closest && el.closest('.dcp-sq');
  return sq ? sq.dataset.sq : null;
}
boardWrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  if (boardLocked || !game) return;
  const name = squareUnder(e);
  if (!name) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const piece = game.get(name);
  if (piece && piece.color === userColor) {
    const again = selected === name;
    selected = name;
    drawBoard(); markMoves(name);
    const img = boardWrap.querySelector(`[data-sq="${name}"] img`);
    drag = { from: name, again, moved: false, startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY,
             ghost: null, src: img ? img.src : null };
  } else if (selected) {
    tryMove(selected, name);
  }
});
document.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  if (!drag) return;
  if (!drag.moved && Math.hypot(e.clientX - drag.startX, e.clientY - drag.startY) > 6) {
    drag.moved = true;
    if (drag.src) {
      const g = document.createElement('img');
      g.src = drag.src; g.className = 'dcp-ghost';
      const s = boardWrap.clientWidth / 8 * 0.92;
      g.style.width = s + 'px'; g.style.height = s + 'px';
      document.body.appendChild(g);
      drag.ghost = g;
      const orig = boardWrap.querySelector(`[data-sq="${drag.from}"] img`);
      if (orig) orig.style.opacity = .35;
    }
  }
  if (drag.ghost) {
    const s = parseFloat(drag.ghost.style.width);
    drag.ghost.style.left = (e.clientX - s / 2) + 'px';
    drag.ghost.style.top = (e.clientY - s / 2) + 'px';
  }
});
document.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  if (!drag) return;
  const d = drag; drag = null;
  if (d.ghost) d.ghost.remove();
  const orig = boardWrap.querySelector(`[data-sq="${d.from}"] img`);
  if (orig) orig.style.opacity = '';
  if (d.moved) {
    const target = squareUnder(e);
    if (target && target !== d.from) tryMove(d.from, target);
    else { selected = null; drawBoard(); }
  } else if (d.again) {                  // second press on the same piece deselects it
    selected = null; drawBoard();
  }
});
document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
  if (!drag) return;
  if (drag.ghost) drag.ghost.remove();
  drag = null; selected = null; drawBoard();
});

function tryMove(from, to) {
  const expected = puzzle.moves[solIdx];                    // UCI like e2e4 or e7e8q
  const uciBase = from + to;
  let promo = '';
  if (expected.slice(0, 4) === uciBase && expected.length === 5) promo = expected[4];
  const legal = game.moves({ square: from, verbose: true }).some(m => m.to === to);
  if (!legal) { selected = null; drawBoard(); return; }
  const played = uciBase + promo;
  if (played !== expected && uciBase !== expected) {
    /* wrong move: show it briefly, then revert */
    const undoMe = game.move({ from, to, promotion: promo || 'q' });
    selected = null; lastMove = { from, to };
    drawBoard();
    flash(to, 'wrongsq');
    setStatus('<span class="bad">Not this one. Try again.</span>');
    boardLocked = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (undoMe) game.undo();
      lastMove = null; boardLocked = false; drawBoard();
    }, 650);
    return;
  }
  game.move({ from, to, promotion: promo || 'q' });
  selected = null; lastMove = { from, to }; hintStage = 0;
  solIdx++;
  drawBoard();
  if (solIdx >= puzzle.moves.length) { puzzleSolved(); return; }
  /* auto-play the opponent reply */
  boardLocked = true;
  setStatus('Good. Keep going…');
  setTimeout(() => {
    const reply = puzzle.moves[solIdx];
    game.move({ from: reply.slice(0, 2), to: reply.slice(2, 4), promotion: reply[4] || 'q' });
    lastMove = { from: reply.slice(0, 2), to: reply.slice(2, 4) };
    solIdx++;
    boardLocked = false;
    drawBoard();
    setStatus('Your move.');
  }, 450);
}

function setStatus(html) { $('dcpStatus').innerHTML = html; }

/* ---------- puzzle flow ---------- */
let puzzles = null;

function startPuzzle() {
  const ctx = activeCtx();
  if (!ctx) return;
  const day = ctx.day, q = quotaOf(day);
  const idx = startIndex(day) + ctx.idx;
  const row = puzzles[idx];
  puzzle = { id: row[0], fen: row[1], moves: row[2].split(' '), rating: row[3], themes: row[4],
             dayTheme: row[5], dayType: row[6] };
  game = new Chess(puzzle.fen);
  solIdx = 0; selected = null; hintStage = 0;
  userColor = game.turn() === 'w' ? 'b' : 'w';             // user moves after the setup move
  $('dcpDayLabel').textContent = ctx.review ? `Reviewing Day ${day}` : `Day ${day} of ${DAYS}`;
  $('dcpPuzzleLabel').textContent = `puzzle ${ctx.idx + 1} of ${q} • rating ${puzzle.rating}` + (ctx.replay ? ' • replay' : '');
  const exitBtn = $('dcpExitReview');
  exitBtn.style.display = (ctx.review || ctx.replay) ? '' : 'none';
  exitBtn.textContent = ctx.replay ? 'Back to current puzzle' : 'Exit review';
  renderTechLabel(day);
  renderQuota();
  boardLocked = true;
  lastMove = null;
  drawBoard();
  setStatus('Watch the opponent’s move…');
  setTimeout(() => {
    const m0 = puzzle.moves[0];
    game.move({ from: m0.slice(0, 2), to: m0.slice(2, 4), promotion: m0[4] || 'q' });
    lastMove = { from: m0.slice(0, 2), to: m0.slice(2, 4) };
    solIdx = 1;
    boardLocked = false;
    drawBoard();
    setStatus(`${userColor === 'w' ? 'White' : 'Black'} to move. Find the best line.`);
  }, 700);
}

function puzzleSolved() {
  boardLocked = true;
  if (reviewDay !== null) return reviewAdvance();
  /* a replayed puzzle was already counted; just drop back to the live one */
  if (liveReplay !== null) {
    liveReplay = null;
    setStatus('<span class="ok">Solved!</span> Back to your current puzzle…');
    setTimeout(startPuzzle, 900);
    return;
  }
  state.cur.solved++;
  const day = state.cur.day, q = quotaOf(day);
  if (state.cur.solved >= q) {
    state.done[day] = todayStr();
    state.cur = null;
    persist();
    renderAll();
    return;
  }
  persist();
  renderQuota();
  setStatus('<span class="ok">Solved!</span> Next puzzle…');
  setTimeout(startPuzzle, 900);
}
function reviewAdvance() {
  reviewIdx++;
  renderQuota();
  if (reviewIdx >= quotaOf(reviewDay)) {
    setStatus('<span class="ok">Review complete.</span> "Retry puzzle" replays this set from the start, or "Exit review" goes back.');
    return;
  }
  setStatus('<span class="ok">Solved!</span> Next puzzle…');
  setTimeout(startPuzzle, 900);
}

$('dcpHint').onclick = () => {
  if (boardLocked || !puzzle || solIdx >= puzzle.moves.length) return;
  const mv = puzzle.moves[solIdx];
  if (hintStage === 0) { flash(mv.slice(0, 2), 'hintsq'); hintStage = 1; }
  else { flash(mv.slice(0, 2), 'hintsq'); flash(mv.slice(2, 4), 'hintsq'); }
};
$('dcpRetry').onclick = () => {
  if (!puzzle) return;
  /* a finished review set has no "current" puzzle to retry -- restart it from puzzle 1 */
  if (reviewDay !== null && reviewIdx >= quotaOf(reviewDay)) { reviewIdx = 0; startPuzzle(); return; }
  if (activeCtx()) startPuzzle();
};

/* ---------- quota pills, stats, phase ---------- */
function renderQuota() {
  const el = $('dcpQuota');
  el.innerHTML = '';
  const ctx = activeCtx();
  if (!ctx) return;
  const q = quotaOf(ctx.day);
  /* in review the whole set is already solved, so any pill may be jumped to;
     in a live session only the solved (green) pills can be replayed */
  const solved = ctx.review ? q : state.cur.solved;
  for (let i = 0; i < q; i++) {
    const clickable = i < solved || ctx.review;
    const p = document.createElement(clickable ? 'button' : 'div');
    const done = ctx.review ? i < ctx.idx : (i < solved && i !== ctx.idx);
    p.className = 'dcp-pill' + (done ? ' done' : (i === ctx.idx ? ' cur' : '')) + (clickable ? ' pick' : '');
    if (clickable) {
      p.type = 'button';
      p.title = `Go to puzzle ${i + 1}`;
      p.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to puzzle ${i + 1} of ${q}`);
      p.onclick = ctx.review
        ? () => { reviewIdx = i; startPuzzle(); }
        : () => { liveReplay = i; startPuzzle(); };
    }
    el.appendChild(p);
  }
}
function renderStats() {
  const n = daysDone();
  $('statDays').textContent = n;
  $('statStreak').textContent = streak();
  $('dcpProg').style.width = (100 * n / DAYS).toFixed(1) + '%';
  const d = currentDay();
  if (d) $('dcpPhase').textContent = `Current phase: ${phaseName(d, quotaOf(d))} (${quotaOf(d)} puzzle${quotaOf(d) > 1 ? 's' : ''} per day)`;
  else $('dcpPhase').textContent = 'Plan complete.';
}

/* ---------- calendar ---------- */
let calY, calM;                                            // displayed month
function renderCalendar() {
  const greens = new Set(Object.values(state.done));
  /* reverse lookup so a click on a date can find which plan-day it completed */
  const dayForDate = {};
  for (const [d, dt] of Object.entries(state.done)) dayForDate[dt] = d;
  const reviewDate = reviewDay !== null ? state.done[reviewDay] : null;
  const first = new Date(calY, calM, 1);
  const title = first.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
  $('calTitle').textContent = title;
  const grid = $('calGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  for (const dow of ['Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa', 'Su']) {
    const h = document.createElement('div'); h.className = 'dcp-cal-dow'; h.textContent = dow; grid.appendChild(h);
  }
  const lead = (first.getDay() + 6) % 7;                   // Monday-first
  for (let i = 0; i < lead; i++) {
    const e = document.createElement('div'); e.className = 'dcp-cal-cell empty'; grid.appendChild(e);
  }
  const nDays = new Date(calY, calM + 1, 0).getDate();
  const tStr = todayStr();
  for (let d = 1; d <= nDays; d++) {
    const cell = document.createElement('div');
    const ds = new Date(calY, calM, d).toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
    const isGreen = greens.has(ds);
    cell.className = 'dcp-cal-cell' + (isGreen ? ' green' : '') + (ds === tStr ? ' today' : '') + (ds === reviewDate ? ' reviewing' : '');
    cell.textContent = d;
    if (isGreen) { cell.title = 'Click to review this day'; cell.onclick = () => startReview(+dayForDate[ds]); }
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  }
}
$('calPrev').onclick = () => { calM--; if (calM < 0) { calM = 11; calY--; } renderCalendar(); };
$('calNext').onclick = () => { calM++; if (calM > 11) { calM = 0; calY++; } renderCalendar(); };

/* ---------- top-level render ---------- */
function renderAll() {
  if (reviewDay !== null || liveReplay !== null) return;   // a background cloud sync must not interrupt an open review or replay
  $('dcpExitReview').style.display = 'none';   // stale from a just-exited review, if any
  renderStats();
  renderCalendar();
  const d = currentDay();
  if (d === null) {
    $('dcpDayLabel').textContent = 'No more puzzles left.';
    $('dcpPuzzleLabel').textContent = '';
    $('dcpQuota').innerHTML = '';
    $('dcpBoard').innerHTML = '';
    $('dcpBoard').style.display = 'none';
    $('dcpHint').disabled = true; $('dcpRetry').disabled = true;
    $('dcpTechLabel').style.display = 'none'; renderPrimer(null);
    setStatus('<div class="dcp-big"><span class="huge">🏆</span><br><b>Congrats!</b> You finished all 1000 days of the plan.</div>');
    return;
  }
  const doneDates = new Set(Object.values(state.done));
  if (doneDates.has(todayStr()) && (!state.cur || state.cur.day !== d)) {
    /* one set per calendar day */
    $('dcpDayLabel').textContent = 'Done for today.';
    $('dcpPuzzleLabel').textContent = `Day ${d} of ${DAYS} unlocks tomorrow.`;
    $('dcpTechLabel').style.display = 'none'; renderPrimer(null);
    $('dcpQuota').innerHTML = '';
    $('dcpBoard').style.display = 'none';
    $('dcpHint').disabled = true; $('dcpRetry').disabled = true;
    setStatus('<span class="ok">Set complete. Come back tomorrow.</span>');
    return;
  }
  $('dcpBoard').style.display = 'grid';
  $('dcpHint').disabled = false; $('dcpRetry').disabled = false;
  if (!state.cur || state.cur.day !== d) state.cur = { day: d, solved: 0 };
  startPuzzle();
}

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
/* Paint from local state right away; the puzzles file starts the first puzzle
   the moment it arrives, and the cloud copy merges in whenever it is ready.
   Nothing on screen ever waits for the network round trips. */
(function init() {
  function renderUser() {
    if (cloudProfile) {
      $('dcpUser').innerHTML = 'Training as <b></b> (synced to your account)';
      $('dcpUser').querySelector('b').textContent = cloudProfile.name;
    } else {
      $('dcpUser').innerHTML = 'Progress is stored in this browser only. Sign in at the top of the page to sync it across devices.';
    }
  }
  renderUser();

  const t = new Date(); calY = t.getFullYear(); calM = t.getMonth();

  state = loadLocal();
  renderStats();
  renderCalendar();

  fetch('chess-assets/daily-puzzles.json')
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => { puzzles = data.puzzles; renderAll(); })
    .catch(() => { $('dcpDayLabel').textContent = 'Could not load the puzzles. Refresh to try again.'; });

  function pullCloud() {
    cloudLoad().then(cloud => {
      if (!cloud) return;
      const merged = mergeStates(state, cloud);
      const changed = JSON.stringify(merged) !== JSON.stringify(state);
      state = merged;
      persist();
      if (changed && puzzles) renderAll();
    });
  }

  /* Sign-in can settle after this page has already painted, so the cloud copy
     merges in whenever identity arrives rather than being read once at start. */
  let wiredUid = null;
  if (window.siteAuth) {
    window.siteAuth.onChange(user => {
      cloudProfile = user
        ? { uid: user.uid, name: (window.siteAuth.handle()) || 'Player' }
        : null;
      renderUser();
      if (cloudProfile && wiredUid !== cloudProfile.uid) {
        wiredUid = cloudProfile.uid;
        pullCloud();
      }
    });
  }
})();
</script>
